notes.title: Gym Manager - full game released!
notes.content:
🌟 Hey Gym Managers! 🌟

It's time for the grand opening! Gym Manager is live, and from today, you can dive into the world of managing your own gym! 🏋️‍♂️✨

Build, expand, and manage your fitness empire. Ready to become the best manager in town? Exciting challenges and loads of fun await you!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798396/7ba8f9bcf49270a1dc14bba57481963eeeea56d6.png

We want to hear your suggestions, opinions, requests, and any other ideas. Your feedback is incredibly important to us and will help make Gym Manager even better!

So, what are you waiting for? Jump into the game today and show us what you’ve got! 💪See you at the gym!

If you're interested in other games in a similar climate, don't forget to check out the Bundle deals!
